gems.title: 欢迎来龙餐馆
gems.titleEn: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
gems.summary: 徐福为养家还债远赴中东中餐馆当厨师，在当地结识了大堂经理马俊生。他们以地道中国风味广招八方来客，龙餐馆声名鹊起。然而随着战争爆发，当地形势急转直下，没有人能够独善其身，徐福和马俊生也不例外，他们的命运将何去何从？战火中的龙餐馆又将如何维系？
gems.summaryEn: Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef in a Chinese restaurant to pay off family debts, where he meets floor manager Ma Junsheng. Their Dragon Restaurant rises to fame, attracting crowds w
gems.whyWatch: 战争烟火中，一家中餐馆撑起人性与乡愁，近年最被低估的华语战争剧情片。
gems.whyWatchEn: In the midst of war, a Chinese restaurant becomes a stage for humanity and nostalgia—a vastly underrated Chinese war drama.
gems.audience: 偏好厚重战争叙事与现实底色的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who prefer weighty war narratives with a grounded, humanistic touch.

gems.title: 夜巡毒枭
gems.summary: 两位墨西哥员警不幸得罪一名残忍的毒枭后，必须拼命撑过值勤的最后几小时。改编自真实事件。
gems.summaryEn: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.
gems.whyWatch: 两名墨西哥警察被毒枭追杀，把最绝望的值班夜拍成了肾上腺素爆表的人性考验。
gems.whyWatchEn: Two Mexican cops hunted by a cartel turn their final shift into an adrenaline-soaked test of survival and honor.
gems.audience: 爱动作犯罪片和真实事件改编的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of action-crime films and true-story adaptations.

gems.title: 爱恋成婚
gems.summary: 新娘结婚后拒绝离开娘家，她的丈夫必须考虑是否能够适应居住在岳父岳母屋檐下的生活。
gems.summaryEn: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.
gems.whyWatch: 新娘婚后不离开娘家，丈夫被迫住进岳父母家，把家庭喜剧玩出了新花样。
gems.whyWatchEn: A bride refuses to leave her family home, forcing her husband to live with his in-laws—a fresh, hilarious twist on marriage comedy.
gems.audience: 喜欢轻松爱情喜剧与家庭关系探讨的人
gems.audienceEn: Those who enjoy lighthearted romantic comedies and family dynamics.

gems.title: 属于我的孩子
gems.summary: 在这部令人震惊的纪录片中，承受家人和社会的期望的女子迫切地想要个孩子，因此假装怀孕，并卷入一起犯罪。
gems.summaryEn: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.
gems.whyWatch: 纪录片揭露女性为生育铤而走险、假装怀孕的惊人犯罪，越看越心寒。
gems.whyWatchEn: A chilling documentary about a woman so desperate for a child that she fakes pregnancy and spirals into crime.
gems.audience: 真实犯罪与心理纪实爱好者

gems.title: 我们未曾有过的
gems.summary: 改编自爱丽丝·凯伦（Alice Kellen）同名畅销小说。失去父母后，有志成为画家的利亚（Leah）难以应对。当她的哥哥搬走后，他请最好的朋友阿克塞尔（Axel）照顾她，却不知道她对他一直以来的感情。
gems.summaryEn: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grap
gems.whyWatch: 改编自畅销小说，暗恋哥哥好友的女孩与守护者之间，一场克制又心动的治愈爱恋。
gems.whyWatchEn: A tender adaptation about a grieving girl and her brother's best friend, where quiet love becomes an unexpected lifeline.
gems.audience: 喜欢细腻催泪爱情片的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who love delicate, tear-jerking romance films.

gems.title: 幸运女神
gems.summary: 一宗涉及数百万美元的劫案搞砸后，骗徒幸儿被迫亡命天涯。在联邦调查局与冷血黑帮大佬的夹击下，幸儿必须为生存而战，设法逃出生天。
gems.summaryEn: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.
gems.whyWatch: 劫案失败后女骗徒亡命天涯，FBI与黑帮双面夹击，短小精悍的犯罪惊悚剧。
gems.whyWatchEn: After a botched heist, a con woman is caught between the FBI and a ruthless mob boss—a taut, bingeable crime thriller.
gems.audience: 喜欢快节奏犯罪剧和女性主角的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of fast-paced crime dramas and compelling female leads.

gems.title: 权力的游戏前传：龙族
gems.summary: 在维斯特洛大陆，坦格利安家族的衰落被公之于众。一场被称为“血龙狂舞”的内战即将爆发。
gems.summaryEn: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins wh
gems.whyWatch: 龙家内战血龙狂舞全面爆发，第三季继续把权游宇宙的史诗感推向巅峰。
gems.whyWatchEn: The Dance of the Dragons ignites as House Targaryen tears itself apart—Season 3 delivers the epic grandeur fans crave.
gems.audience: 权游迷与宏大奇幻史诗爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Game of Thrones fans and lovers of grand fantasy epics.
